prompt: Our real-time chat feature shows a "user is typing…" indicator in group rooms using a NestJS + Socket.IO gateway. It works, but under load the WebSocket layer is saturated — in busy rooms (up to ~200 members) the server is relaying a huge volume of `typing` frames, because the client fires one on every keystroke and the gateway blindly re-broadcasts each one to the whole room. Below is the current implementation (server gateway, client input, and receiver indicator). The typing indicator is purely cosmetic and the receiver already auto-fades it after ~1.5s of silence, so please walk me through how you'd optimize this flow so the visible behavior is identical but the traffic drops dramatically — without introducing any persistence round-trip.
